newsitem.title: USA: RESEARCH ALERT-Tribune Q3 EPS view raised.
newsitem.headline: RESEARCH ALERT-Tribune Q3 EPS view raised.

text.p: --Prudential Securities said Thursday it raised its estimate on Tribune Co's fully diluted earnings per share from continuing operations to $0.86 from a previous estimate of $0.77 for the third quarter. The year-ago diluted EPS for the Q3 from continuing operations was $0.55.
--"This implies primary earnings per share of about $0.92 versus $0.61 from continuing operations in the Q3 of 1995," noted analyst Melissa Cook in a report.
--Cook said she trimmed $0.05 off her Q4 estimate to reflect the current soft trends being reported by television broadcasters throughout the industry.

--"We are increasing our full-year 1996 estimate from $3.70 per share (fully diluted) to $3.75 per share, to reflect the stronger Q3 outlook," Cook noted. "On a primary basis, our estimate was $4 per share. We now look for $4.05."
--Cook said the upward Q3 revisions reflect an expectation that newspapers and educational publishing could post stronger results than originally anticipated.
